name: Manduka PRO™ Yoga Mat 6mm
description:
A studio-quality yoga mat with unmatched stability and a lifetime guarantee.

The PRO is a high-density yoga mat built to support your home practice.
Crafted in Germany since 1997, it delivers floor-like stability with comfortable joint protection, and unmatched durability. A hygienic, closed-cell surface keeps sweat, moisture, and bacteria out of your mat, making it easy to clean and maintain for long-term performance. When you're ready to invest in your home practice, trust the mat that’s built to last with a lifetime guarantee.

name: Almost Perfect GRP® Adapt Lite 2.0 Yoga Mat 4mm
titleOriginal: Almost Perfect GRP® Adapt Lite 2.0 Yoga Mat 4mm
description:
The GRP Adapt Lite 2.0 delivers the moisture-responsive grip and cushioned comfort that define the GRP Adapt series. Its Satin Grip™ surface and Moisture Flow scrim absorb and disperse moisture quickly to help maintain consistent grip.
Why is it Almost Perfect? The difference is in the floor traction.This first batch was produced without the Versa-Grip™ base layer found on the now updated GRP Adapt Lite 2.1. As a result, the mat may shift or gather during faster, more dynamic movement, or hot yoga. Rather than discard an otherwise functional mat, we chose to offer it through our UNWASTED program at 40% off.
With 4mm of cushioned support and a lighter profile, it is best suited for restorative yoga, slower flows, and home practice. The GRP Adapt Lite 2.0 extends the life of thoughtfully made product while providing a great option for practitioners who do not require maximum floor stability.
Crafted in Spain from 20% recycled materials, PU, and Natural Rubber.
